We shipped rank 1. The app keeps rituals in the `spells` bucket and reads their printed level off `rank` (scripts/field-diff.mjs:60 maps the spells bucket through `(r) => r.rank`), so the printed Ritual 3 is rank 3 here. No graded-family heading is involved: ritual-275's markdown carries exactly one `right=` heading and `printedLevel` does not match `Ritual`, so the value falls back to the document's own structured level 3 — heading and structured field agree and the batch-035 own-document guard still reports it.
